-- name: SetIssueCurrentIterationBatch :batchone
UPDATE issue SET current_iteration_id = $1,
    iteration_rollover_count = $2, revision = revision + 1,
    updated_at = $3, last_activity_at = $3
WHERE workspace_id = $4 AND id = $5
